objective_value: <float> Total time required, equal to setup times of all used patterns plus cutting times of all pattern repetitions.

<key: '{pattern_index}'>.used: <bool> Whether this pattern is selected for use on the cutting machine.
<key: '{pattern_index}'>.repetitions: <int> Number of times this pattern is repeated on the cutting machine.
<key: '{pattern_index}'>.pieces: <dict, key: '{product_id}'> Number of pieces of each product cut in a single pass of this pattern.

extra_pieces: <dict, key: '{product_id}'> Number of extra pieces of each product produced via the open end of the machine across all pattern repetitions.
production_quantities: <dict, key: 'product_{product_id}_pattern_{pattern_index}'> Total number of pieces of each product produced by each pattern, equal to the pieces per pass multiplied by the number of repetitions.
